author: Ari Koslow
title: Josh Naylor (wrist) out of lineup Wednesday
desc: Josh Naylor is not in the Mariners lineup on Wednesday against the Orioles.
impact: Naylor remains day-to-day with a wrist issue. Miles Mastrobuoni gets another start at first base in his place.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luke Raley (back) not in lineup Wednesday
desc: Luke Raley remains out of the Mariners lineup on Wednesday against the Orioles.
impact: Raley remains day-to-day with back tightness. Connor Joe draws the start in left field with Victor Robles in right field.

author: Chase Davis
title: Tanner Scott logs second save in as many days
desc: Tanner Scott struck out two in a scoreless frame to earn the save in Tuesday's 1-0 win over the Rays.
impact: After Tuesday's win, Scott now has a 2.32 ERA and 0.71 WHIP with nine saves, one blown save and five holds across 33 appearances. He was scuffling along to start the month, but has three straight clean outings with a save.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Weiss sent outright to Triple-A
desc: The Astros sent RHP Ryan Weiss outright to Triple-A Sugar Land.
impact: Weiss passed through waivers unclaimed. He will remain in the Astros organization.

author: Chase Davis
title: Justin Wrobleski cruises in 1-0 win over Rays
desc: Justin Wrobleski allowed zero earned runs on three hits and no walks while striking out five over six innings in Tuesday's 1-0 win over Tampa Bay.
impact: After the win, Wrobleski owns a 2.72 ERA and 1.01 WHIP with a 8-2 record across 13 starts. He did give up 11 hard-hit balls, so he may be lucky to walk away with only three hits allowed. Still, he logged the quality start in only 67 pitches. He'll have a favorable matchup with the Twins next time through the rotation.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Fried (elbow) to throw bullpen this weekend
desc: Max Fried is scheduled to throw another bullpen session this weekend.
impact: Fried also threw a bullpen on Tuesday. If all goes well this weekend, he could be cleared to face live hitters as early as next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kahlil Watson recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Guardians recalled OF Kahlil Watson from Triple-A Columbus.
impact: Watson earns his first trip to the majors. He was slashing .255/.370/.491 with 12 homers and 15 steals in 56 games at Triple-A this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chase DeLauter (rib) placed on IL
desc: The Guardians placed OF Chase DeLauter on the 10-day injured list with a right rib fracture.
impact: DeLauter underwent imaging earlier this week revealed a bone bruise and a small fracture in his right ribs. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ronald Acuna Jr. (hamstring) 'long way' from returning
desc: Braves manager Walt Weiss said Wednesday that Ronald Acuna is a "long way" from returning from the injured list.
impact: Acuna missed nearly three weeks in May with a left hamstring strain and landed back on the IL one week ago with the same injury. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yimi Garcia (elbow) to make another rehab appearance Thursday
desc: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said Yimi Garcia will make another rehab appearance on Thursday.
impact: Garcia struck out the side in his latest rehab appearance on Tuesday. He should be close to being ready to be activated.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Will Brennan sent outright to Triple-A
desc: The Giants sent Will Brennan outright to Triple-A Sacramento.
impact: Brennan passed through waivers unclaimed after he was designated for assignment. He will remain in the Giants organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt Gage (knee) activated from IL
desc: The Giants activated Matt Gage from the injured list.
impact: Gage makes his return from the IL as was previously reported to happen this week. Reiver Sanmartin was optioned as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Reiver Sanmartin optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Giants optioned Reiver Sanmartin to Triple-A Sacramento.
impact: Sanmartin returns to Triple-A to make room for Matt Gage. He should get another opportunity later in the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Anthony Molina optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Braves optioned RHP Anthony Molina to Triple-A Gwinnett.
impact: Molina will return to Triple-A after being called up over the weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jair Camargo to serve as 27th man in doubleheader Wednesday
desc: Jair Camargo will serve as the 27th man for Wednesday's doubleheader against the Giants.
impact: Camargo will add an extra option behind the plate for Atlanta.
